document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The summoned creatures are powerful indeed. Though many fall 
before the might of the shoggoths, others manage to destroy the 
Top before it can be set in motion. But a battle between alien 
horrors is no place for a human to be. You edge away from the 
horrifying struggle.
Dazed, you stumble back into the numbing Antarctic cold. 
Somehow you reach the Dornier and safety. Jones may be there 
to fly you back, or Crawford may dispatch a rescue flight if you 
have no Pilot (Aircraft) skill. 
You are diagnosed as having Dementia Antarctica. Ultimately 
you realize, after your release from a New England sanatorium 
that it is best to say nothing about your trip. It is ... THE END, 
but you triumphed where many failed. Congratulations!
(565, 566, 572)
